description: Target-specific volatile-field exclusions for deterministic replay comparison. Only explicitly listed paths are excluded; all other target-result fields are compared.
limitations: Replay comparison is available only for targets with an explicit stability profile.
Only listed volatile paths are removed. New volatile fields require a reviewed policy update.
A matching target-result projection demonstrates deterministic replay for the selected case, target, code commit, and bundled resource versions; it does not establish semantic correctness.
